LanguageData.AAF.OpenFilterTip: Open the attribute filter to build rules that toggle apparel in this policy by armor, insulation, coverage and other stats.
LanguageData.AAF.Title: Apparel Attribute Filter
LanguageData.AAF.MaterialScopeTip: Material rules always apply to the whole policy, they can't be limited to a single layer.
LanguageData.AAF.NoRules: No rules yet.\nPick an attribute on the left to add one.
LanguageData.AAF.CopyTip: Copy this ruleset to the clipboard so it can be pasted into another apparel policy.
LanguageData.AAF.PasteTip: Replace this policy's ruleset with the copied one. Applies only after you press Apply or Save.
LanguageData.AAF.EvalAsTip: How to read armor and insulation for stuffable apparel. "Multiplier" uses the material-effect multiplier so any piece that can take armor/insulation counts. Pick a material to instead use the actual value that material would give (only affects apparel that can be made from it).
LanguageData.AAF.ApplyTip: Recompute the policy from scratch: allow all apparel, then remove every piece disqualified by a rule. Overwrites the policy's current toggles, and saves these rules.
LanguageData.AAF.SaveTip: Save these rules without changing the policy's current apparel toggles.
